concept: Revised final design (the 'character' design with the judges' grafts and all eleven review fixes applied). The scar is shown literally but only through one eye slit of the mask (no mask-off image); he mends a cracked column with one thought and then stops his own hand short of his face (no green glow anywhere). A bored flick of his hand calls clouds and snow over his open terrace, and that snow becomes the film's own time device: on 'leave' it hangs in the air, on 'throne' it starts to rise, the towers behind the throne un-build one by one in a tight long-lens view, and the same mountains stand over a poor camp where the snow falls normally again. There a small boy in a too-big green shawl already has the mask's scowl (until a snowflake lands on his nose). The close is a strict before/after pair on one triangle: a gold cradle with a white bundle under a pointed red-and-gold canopy in the ordinary king's stone room, crowned on 'born'; then a patched tent with its peak on the same screen point, a mother's shadow rocking the same bundle shape, crowned only by a slab of snow on 'tent'.
